profile.headline: Technical Program Manager | Scrum Master | Software Engineer | Agile Delivery | Engineering Operations | AI & Automation | Process Optimization
profile.summary:
I believe great engineering organizations are built on more than great code—they are built on strong collaboration, scalable processes, and continuous improvement.
 
Throughout my career, I have combined my software engineering background with Technical Program Management to help cross-functional engineering teams deliver complex technical initiatives while improving the way they work together.
 
Beyond Agile delivery, I enjoy building systems that create leverage for engineering organizations. From Jira and Confluence automations that reduced manual documentation by over 50%, to AI-powered GPT solutions that streamlined project management, my passion lies in removing friction so teams can focus on solving meaningful technical problems.
 
I thrive in environments where collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence come together, and I enjoy partnering with engineers, product managers, architects, QA, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions that create measurable impact.
 
Areas of expertise include:
 
• Technical Program Management
 • Agile Delivery
 • Engineering Operations
 • AI & Automation
 • Cross-functional Leadership
 • Process Optimization
 • Jira & Confluence Administration
 • Risk & Dependency Management
 • Executive Reporting & KPI Development
 
I am always excited to connect with teams building innovative technology and improving engineering organizations through collaboration, automation, and continuous learning.

positions.title: IT Project Manager II (Technical Program Management)
positions.description:
Led Agile software delivery across cross-functional engineering teams supporting enterprise eCommerce platforms and digital customer experiences. Partnered with Engineering, Product, QA, UX, and business stakeholders to deliver complex technical initiatives while improving engineering productivity through automation, AI, and scalable delivery processes.
 
𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗔𝗰𝗵𝗶𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀
 
• Designed Jira and Confluence automations that reduced manual documentation effort by 50%+ and were adopted by multiple Project Managers.
• Developed AI-powered GPT solutions that automated project documentation, executive reporting, stakeholder communications, and engineering knowledge management, significantly improving Project Manager productivity.
• Designed engineering dashboards that provided real-time visibility into Sprint Health, Capacity, Velocity, Release Metrics, and delivery risks, enabling proactive decision-making.
• Spearheaded Agile delivery across distributed engineering teams, facilitating Scrum ceremonies, PI Planning, Release Planning, and cross-functional program execution.
• Implemented Release Governance, UAT workflows, and standardized engineering documentation to improve delivery quality and consistency.
• Coordinated technical initiatives while managing dependencies, risks, release readiness, and stakeholder communication.
• Drove continuous improvement initiatives focused on automation, AI adoption, and operational excellence.

𝗖𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘁𝗶𝘀𝗲
 
Technical Program Management | Engineering Operations | Agile Delivery | Scrum | Kanban | Jira | Confluence | AI | Automation | SDLC | Release Management | Stakeholder Management
 
Delivered scalable engineering processes and automation solutions that improved team productivity, documentation consistency, and operational efficiency across multiple engineering teams.
positions.insights: Engineering Operations, Agile Methodologies and +18 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Contributed to the development and delivery of enterprise eCommerce solutions while partnering closely with Product Owners, QA, Architects, and engineering teams. Built a strong technical foundation in Agile software development, cross-functional collaboration, and software delivery that later enabled a successful transition into Technical Program Management.

𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗔𝗰𝗵𝗶𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀
 
• Designed, developed, tested, and maintained scalable enterprise software solutions following Agile methodologies and SDLC best practices.
• Partnered with Product Owners and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
• Actively contributed to backlog refinement, sprint planning, estimation, code reviews, release activities, and production support.
• Collaborated across Engineering, QA, Product, and Architecture teams to deliver high-quality software while balancing technical requirements, business priorities, and release timelines.
• Supported Scrum and delivery management activities while progressively taking ownership of delivery coordination, stakeholder communication, and cross-functional collaboration prior to promotion to IT Project Manager II.
• Contributed to continuous improvement initiatives focused on engineering quality, Agile practices, and delivery efficiency.

𝗖𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘁𝗶𝘀𝗲
 
Software Engineering | Agile | Scrum | SDLC | Git | Jira | Java | AEM (Adobe Experience Manager) | Confluence | Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) | Debugging | Software Development | Cross-functional Collaboration


Built the technical foundation that continues to strengthen my ability to lead engineering organizations, communicate effectively with software teams, and successfully deliver complex technical programs.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer (Technical Leadership)
positions.description:
Led the design and delivery of custom software solutions and enterprise API integrations for Sistema TRESS, partnering directly with stakeholders and engineering teams to deliver business-critical functionality. Served as a technical leader by mentoring developers, participating in architectural decisions, improving engineering practices, and supporting the organization's transition from Delphi to C#/.NET modern technologies.

𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗔𝗰𝗵𝗶𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀

• Delivered 20+ custom software projects annually, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
• Partnered directly with stakeholders to define requirements, create user stories with acceptance criteria, and drive successful project delivery.
• Served as the primary technical point of contact during manager absences, coordinating priorities and stakeholder communication.
• Mentored new developers, performed code reviews, and promoted engineering best practices across multiple teams.
• Partnered with engineering leadership on effort estimation, technical feasibility, and architecture discussions to support project planning.
• Contributed to the migration from Delphi to C#/.NET while developing and maintaining enterprise API integrations.
• Supported the team's transition from Kanban to Scrumban, improving planning, collaboration, and delivery workflows.

𝗖𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘁𝗶𝘀𝗲

Technical Leadership | Stakeholder Management | API Development | Agile Delivery | Scrumban | Kanban | User Stories | Code Reviews | Mentoring | Delphi | C# | .NET | SDLC
